int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc == 1) {
        // behave like pandoc with no args: do nothing and exit 0
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        char *arg = argv[i];
        if (strcmp(arg, "--help") == 0 || strcmp(arg, "-h") == 0) {
            printf("%s", help_text);
            return 0;
        }
        if (strcmp(arg, "--version") == 0 || strcmp(arg, "-v") == 0) {
            printf("%s", version_text);
            return 0;
        }
        if (strcmp(arg, "--list-input-formats") == 0) {
            printf("%s", inputs_text);
            return 0;
        }
        if (strcmp(arg, "--list-output-formats") == 0) {
            printf("%s", outputs_text);
            return 0;
        }
        if (strncmp(arg, "--list-extensions", 17) == 0) {
            // support both --list-extensions=fmt and --list-extensions fmt
            char fmt[256] = "";
            if (arg[17] == '=') {
                strncpy(fmt, arg+18, sizeof(fmt)-1);
            } else if (i+1 < argc) {
                strncpy(fmt, argv[i+1], sizeof(fmt)-1);
            }
            if (strcmp(fmt, "markdown") == 0) {
                printf("%s", ext_markdown_text);
                return 0;
            }
            // unknown format: print nothing
            return 0;
        }
        if (strcmp(arg, "--list-highlight-languages") == 0) {
            printf("%s", highlight_langs_text);
            return 0;
        }
        if (strcmp(arg, "--list-highlight-styles") == 0) {
            printf("%s", highlight_styles_text);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
